Semmel.et: From Middle High German semele, Old High German semala, from Proto-West Germanic *similā (“wheat flour”). Compare Yiddish זעמל (zeml).

Semit.et:
Sem + -it.
Coined by members of the Göttingen School of History in the 1770s, after the biblical name Sem (“Shem”).
